file.emptyPrompt: Click to browse for a video file

method.heading: Removal method
method.solidFillDescription: Paint a solid color over the area
method.cloneStampDescription: Copy nearby pixels over the watermark
method.temporalNote: Slower than the other methods, but the edges come out natural. Best where the background moves — a pan, a handheld shot, a moving subject.
method.temporalTooltip: Reads the frames either side of each one and follows the motion between them, so the area behind the mark is recovered from a frame that actually shows it rather than guessed at. A higher quality looks further and blends more carefully, and takes longer.
method.temporalPreviewFast: Previews always run at {quality} so they come back quickly; the export uses the setting above.
method.temporalNeedsMemory: Needs at least 4 GB of memory
method.deepLearningHint: Uses a trained model (ProPainter) on the GPU. Better on hard shots — a locked-off camera, a still background — where there is no other frame to recover the area from. Slower to start, and the first run downloads about 200 MB of model files.
method.deepNote: The model runs on the graphics card. If it cannot run — no card, not enough video memory, or the model is not installed — the export still completes using the standard temporal fill, and says so.
method.deepDowngrade: This card runs the {quality} preset; the setting above is beyond its video memory.
method.deepPreviewFast: Previews always run the fast preset on the deep engine.

actions.previewWarning: Longer preview takes more processing time

status.temporalFallback: {degraded} of {total} frames could not be rebuilt from nearby frames — those were filled from the frame itself, the way Smart Fill does it. They may look softer than the rest.

stages.temporalProcessing: Temporal fill in progress — this takes longer…
stages.deepProcessing: Deep learning fill in progress — this takes longer…

presets.heading: Presets
presets.cloneLeftDescription: Marks near the top or bottom edge
presets.temporalHighDescription: The cleanest edges, and the longest wait

errors.ffmpeg: Could not read or write the video. The file may be corrupted, or in a format this build of FFmpeg does not support.
errors.pythonMissing: The Python environment is missing. Run ./dev.sh to create it, then restart the app.
errors.backendMissing: This installation is incomplete — the processing backend is missing. Reinstalling should fix it.
errors.permission: No permission to write there. Choose a different output location.
errors.diskFull: The disk is full. Free some space or choose another location, then try again.
errors.inputMissing: The video file is no longer where it was. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
errors.roiOutside: The selection sits outside the video frame. Draw the box over the area you want removed.
errors.invalidConfig: The app sent the backend a selection or setting it could not use. Redraw the box over the area you want removed, then try again.
errors.noVideoStream: That file has no video track, so there is nothing to process.
errors.outOfMemory: Ran out of memory processing this video. A shorter clip, or a smaller selection, should get through.
errors.timeout: The job took too long and was stopped. Try a shorter video, or a smaller selection.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong, and the backend gave no reason.
errors.temporalUnsupported: Temporal fill needs at least 4 processor cores and 4 GB of memory. Choose another removal method for this machine.
errors.jobRunning: Another job is already running. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it.
errors.previewTimeout: Still waiting for a preview of this video after 90 seconds. It may be very large, or the backend may be stuck — try loading it again.

deep.needsVram: Needs at least 4 GB of video memory
deep.notInstalled: The ProPainter model is not installed
deep.fallbackBody: The deep learning engine could not run, so the export was completed with the optical-flow engine instead.
deep.qualityBody: The graphics card did not have the video memory for the setting you picked, so the next one down was used.

subscription.heading: Subscription
subscription.paymentHint: Subscribing generates a payment QR code (simulated).
subscription.paySimulated: Demo build: no payment is taken and no card or account is charged.
subscription.autoRenewOff: Auto-renewal is off — access ends on the date above
subscription.autoRenewCancelled: Auto-renewal cancelled. Your plan runs to the end of the period you paid for.
subscription.trialEndedBody: Temporal fill and longer previews need a subscription. Everything you have made stays yours.
subscription.lockedPreview: Previews are limited to 1 second without a subscription
subscription.benefitTemporal: Temporal fill, including the deep learning engine
subscription.faqRefundBody: Cancel auto-renewal at any time; the plan runs to the end of the period you already paid for. Within 7 days of a first purchase, write to support for a full refund.
subscription.faqTrial: What happens when the trial ends?
subscription.faqTrialBody: The app keeps working with the basic fill methods. Temporal fill and the longer previews need a plan.
subscription.faqDevices: Which devices does a plan cover?
subscription.faqDevicesBody: The plan is stored on this machine in this build. Account-based licensing arrives with the real payment integration.
